patch.summary: ServiceNow cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: ServiceNow pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: ServiceNow cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price ServiceNow against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, change and problem management, service catalog) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: No published self-serve price — procurement and SI partners are the buying motion. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Enterprises standardising ITSM (and often HRSD/CSM) on one platform requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: No published self-serve price — procurement and SI partners are the buying motion

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Implementation cost often exceeds year-one licences

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Module sprawl (ITOM, HRSD, CSM) can dwarf ITSM seat cost

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Poor fit as an SMB published-price alternative to Freshservice Starter

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not an observability, git, or hosting-panel product
